hero.title: Architectural Precision.
hero.subtitle: Design and manufacture premium custom headwear with our bespoke 3D configurator. For discerning collectors and corporate clients.

b2b.title: B2B Services & Bulk Orders
b2b.description: Elevate your brand with uncompromising quality. Our dedicated B2B portal offers streamlined bulk ordering, custom labeling, and dedicated account management for professional volume requirements.
b2b.feature1Body: Scale your production efficiently without compromising on bespoke details.
b2b.feature2Body: Transparent, algorithmic volume discounts applied instantly at checkout.
b2b.embroideryBody: Industry-leading stitch density for flawless brand reproduction on every piece.

process.title: The Process
process.description: A streamlined, technically robust progression from concept to physical manifestation, utilizing our proprietary 3D rendering engine.
process.step1Body: Choose your silhouette, fabric weight, and base color from our premium catalog.
process.step2Body: Upload assets, define embroidery coordinates, and preview in real-time 3D space.
process.step3Body: Order submitted to our facility for exacting manufacture and quality assurance.

privacidad.title: Personal data processing
privacidad.intro: This page explains what data we ask for when submitting a quote request and how we handle it, under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012.
privacidad.whatBody: Name, email, phone and, if you want to leave them, additional comments. No other personal data is stored in the system.
privacidad.whyBody: To respond to your quote request and coordinate your cap's production. We don't use it for advertising or share it with third parties.
privacidad.retentionBody: 12 months from when the request reaches a final status (quoted-closed or rejected). After that, the personal data is deleted automatically; the design and the request's history are kept because they aren't personal data.
privacidad.anonymizationBody: Write to us with your request's code and ask for anonymization. The team applies it from the panel; the action can't be undone.
